title: Advent of the Europeans in India

faqs.q: Who gave Prince Henry of Portugal a bull in 1454 conferring the right to navigate to the Orient?
In which year did Constantinople fall to the Ottoman Turks?
Under the Treaty of Tordesillas, which line was used to divide the non-Christian world between Portugal and Spain?

options.b: A line through the Strait of Gibraltar
options.d: A line 1,300 miles west of the Cape Verde Islands

faqs.a: A line 1,300 miles west of the Cape Verde Islands
faqs.e: The treaty was signed in 1494; Portugal could claim territory east of the line, Spain west of it.

faqs.e: Almeida's son was killed in this battle; Almeida avenged the defeat the following year by crushing the two navies.

faqs.e: The siege began on June 24, 1632, and ended three months later after the Portuguese seized two slave girls of Mumtaz Mahal.

faqs.q: Which Deccan power captured Salsette and Bassein from the Portuguese in 1739?

faqs.e: The Portuguese, the first Europeans to reach India, were also the last to leave.

faqs.q: Which battle in November 1759 dealt a crushing blow to Dutch ambitions in India?
faqs.e: The Dutch were defeated by the English after Dutch forces had captured three homebound English ships in the Bay of Bengal; this battle is also referred to as the Battle of Hooghly in the text, ending Dutch ambitions in India.
